\chapter{The Second Form Line: Language}
\label{ch:pa-form-language}
\hlchaptermodality{17}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can select between two separately practised values and fill one requested Gurmukhi language line from a nonverbal cue with no model.}

The learner fills one language field from a nonverbal cue after selection, supported entry, delayed entry, spelling, spacing, and repair have each received a bounded pass.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[two language-value cues]{Select one known language value}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-language-select}



\begin{quote}
Read the closed bank once:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Script — attach one cue to each value}
Point to A, then \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}. Point to B, then \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}}. Cover the bank and say which value B requests. Selection is separate from spelling.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal, point, cover, and select once more. Do not write the form line yet.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This cue belongs only to this two-item practice bank.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[language field]{Fill one supported language field}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-language-supported}



\begin{quote}
Keep this bank visible:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}
\end{quote}

>

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — model visible}
Complete \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for A. Read the label, select the A value, and copy it. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Compare selection, spelling, spacing, and placement in separate passes.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one supported line.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[language field after a short delay]{Hide, wait, then fill the language field}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-language-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Read A — \textbf{\pa{ਪੰਜਾਬੀ}}, B — \textbf{\pa{ਹਿੰਦੀ}} once. Hide the bank and count slowly to ten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — short delayed entry}
With the bank hidden, complete \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_} for B. Finish the attempt before revealing the bank.

\subsection*{Your turn}
Reveal and compare selection, spelling, spacing, then placement. Repair one dimension only.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
One delayed line is enough today.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[language field]{One no-model language field}

\label{lesson:PA-W03-language-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close the previous lesson. There is no value bank, support-language label, or romanized answer below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the requested field:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\pa{ਭਾਸ਼ਾ}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the known value attached to A and write it from memory. Do not reopen an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare selection, spelling, spacing, and placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This closes only the language-field ladder. The remaining form fields are still separate backlog work.
\end{tcolorbox}
